app.name: GestaltX
app.subtitle: MobileGestalt editor for iOS 27
app.localizedDescription:
A MobileGestalt editor for iPhone and iPad, with region-code tweaks, device presets, a CacheExtra field editor, automatic backups and per-preset restore.

On-device MobileGestalt access requires iOS / iPadOS 27.x; on iOS 26.x only local plist editing works. When re-signing, keep the share extension and give the app and the extension the same App Group.

For security research and educational purposes only. Use it only on devices you own or are authorized to manage.
